meta.counting_rule: A drop is catalogued only when a source consulted at build time verifies it exists as a Sonny Angel USA release. Dates marked approx are year level estimates from the cited source and are labelled as such on the page.
meta.known_gaps: Japan only artist collections, older seasonal runs before 2019, plush, bobbing head and accessory lines are out of scope for this river and are named here rather than silently missing. The river grows by rotation.
